messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: release promo paused. Multiple staging jobs failing while extracting layers from registry cache. DeployBot put a hold.

DeployBot: Promotion paused by deploy-bot at 3422223333. Reason: registry-cache-partial-object (layer read EOF) on 5/7 staging runners. See https://ci.redwood/builds/11234 :warning:

Megan: quick log from runner-3:
```
ERROR unpacking layer sha256:abc123: unexpected EOF while decompressing
expected 8192000 bytes, got 5242880
```

storage-bot: Registry metrics: increased 499s from edge-cache us-west-2 between 02:10-02:18 UTC. Storage ticket ST-1501 created.

Ravi: Options: A) pin staging to last-known-good digest to meet change window (~30m left). B) rebuild+push new image+invalidate cache and wait (~15-25m). C) attempt cache purge (uncertain propagation). What prefers ops?

Megan: Pin is fastest. Do pin + trigger rebuild+push in background with `REGISTRY_VALIDATE=1` and new cache key. Then retarget once propagation verified.

oncall-eng: If pinning, make sure we annotate release notes & create rollback playbook. Also enable alert for `image.unpack.errors` during rollout.

CI-Runner-Bot: queued `/ci retry builds/11234 --scope=image-unpack` (4 runners).

Ravi: Manual promote command: `/deploy promote --env=staging --service=checkout-api --digest=sha256:knowngood --reason="pin to unblock release window"` needs 2 approvals.

Megan: +1

oncall-eng: +1

DeployBot: Promote executed: checkout-api (staging) -> sha256:knowngood at 3422223399. Comment: pinned to unblock release window.

Megan: kicked off rebuild with `BUILD_CACHE=off` and `CHUNK_SIZE=4MB`. Pushing new digest sha256:newpush with validation.

storage-bot: Storage team will disable the suspect cache node and run integrity sweep. Ticket ST-1501 assigned.

Ravi: Verify jobs passing on retried runners. Timeline: pin now, smoke checks T+5m, retarget when new push verified (~T+12m). Postmortem owners: Megan (artifact pipeline) + storage-team. I'll add release note entry.

Megan: will add cache-key suffix and upload healthcheck. Filing a short postmortem after this. :thumbsup:
